paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2023 - A Survey of mmWave-based Human Sensing Technology, Platform and Applications
title: A Survey of mmWave-based Human Sensing: Technology, Platforms and Applications
motivation: 现有survey缺乏对mmWave人体感知技术的综合综述,无法指导领域发展
problem_framing: 将mmWave人体感知按感知粒度分为四类:跟踪定位/运动识别/生物特征测量/成像
key_insight: 需系统性总结技术平台、关键算法和应用场景,指出核心挑战与未来方向
method_signature: 综述+分类比较+挑战分析+未来方向建议
evaluation_criteria: 文献完整性/分类合理性/性能对比详尽程度/挑战揭示深度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 现有FMCW雷达受限于天线数量,导致角分辨率有限、点云输出不足、鲁棒性脆弱
evidence_for_taste: most of them are limited in the number of antennas
There is still a significant gap
How to overcome these differences between individuals
This leads to limited angular resolution
thinking_moves: 从性能鸿沟反推研究空白,强调survey的必要性
将人体感知挑战归类为移动性/SNR/个体差异三大类
